public_schedule: Three ABBA rounds per case; six observations per build per case; no discarded samples.

scopes.time_s: External process launch to exit, using unchanged harness.run_arm.run; independent Rust verification is outside this timer.
scopes.peak_device_bytes: Maximum whole-device NVML usage during each command, sampled every 10 ms.
scopes.cairo_proof_execute_finish_s: Existing proof_execute_and_decode_ns, which ends at proof.finish before canonical decoding, verification and publication.
scopes.circuit_execute_finish_s: Existing resident-phase schedule_ns plus finish_ns, excluding planning, static hashing, ingress and decoding.
scopes.diagnostic_execute_finish_sum_s: Sum of the reported Cairo and circuit intervals; a diagnostic sum, not a trusted proof-only score or a pipeline critical-path timer.
scopes.device_stage_ns: Existing CUDA event intervals from Cairo telemetry, in canonical Stage order.
scopes.paired_ratio: For each round, mean(candidate pair)/mean(baseline pair), then median over three rounds.
scopes.baseline_aa_ratio: Within each ABBA round, second baseline observation divided by first baseline observation.

focused.scope: synchronous circuit grind call including allocation, transfers, kernel execution, synchronization, free
focused.schedule: 15 fresh prefixes per channel/width; ABBA per prefix; 30 observations per arm
